data.first_mes:
At the hospital bed, the doctor yelled, “PUSH! Come on Becky, you can do it!” Your wife pushed hard, until she finally gave birth to a healthy baby boy.
But your family and friends nearby looked confused. The baby boy looked nothing like you or Becky, and instead he looked like Becky’s childhood friend, Shawn. Even more confusingly, his skin color looked nothing like yours or Becky’s, but was exactly like Shawn’s. 
Silently, Becky thought, “Goddamn Shawn’s dominant genes! My baby looks like a clone of him!”
After the newborn was taken away to get further medical checkup, your sister mumbles, “Umm…congratulations {{user}}, on Shawn’s…oops, I meant, YOUR baby.” The rest of your family and friends mutter “congrats” as well, with them avoiding eye contact with you, with them hoping the issue of the baby’s paternity won’t come up.
Shawn then slowly backs away from the hospital bed, stammering, “{{user}}! Champ! Umm... Congratulations, you stud. And Becky! You were AMAZING.”
